scope: Public PHerc0841 supervised continuous-correspondence validation; no target data or readings
selection: Source crop selected by labels plus geometry before any reader outputs; reference fixed from source geometry. Neither labels nor reader maps choose UV correspondences.
implementation: New schema2 bilinear correspondence, distance bound50um, controls/correlation/gain bars unchanged. Require separate code/test freeze amendment before any reader maps; keep legacy schema1 readout distinct.

reader.order: Require official-published CT-only orientation/raster comparison on source and reference before maps; no label-based depth-order choice.

correction_selection: Apply frozen schema2 on baseline,reference,minus1,plus1 maps only. Existing alternating-row subsets are correlated spatial diagnostics, not independent validation samples. Never select/retry offsets using human labels.
primary_accuracy: Only if corrections accepted, rerender combined mesh with official engine and infer all3 matched controls. Compare whole640crop inner64 fixed supervised AUC to baseline, count zeros. Also report fixed edited-support mask and fixed upper/lower halves. No surrogate assembled patch map.
edited_support: A pixel is affected if any of the4native corners of its bilinear cell changed; intersect with fixed inner64 supervision. Computed only from accepted geometry, never map scores.
success_gate: Combined rerender forward AUC improvement >=.01, paired95%block-bootstrap lower bound>0, positive wholecrop AUC differences in both fixed halves with>=1000pixels of each class, and forward beats reverse/shuffle with simultaneous lower bounds>0. HP improvement requires positive pairedHP lower bound and greaterthan both depthcontrols and displaced-labelnull. No acceptedgeometry or failedgate => no successfulcorrection claim.

candidate_audit: Report all3sourceoffsets x3directions, independent ofacceptance. Simultaneousmax-centeredbootstrap deviation intervals for two candidate-minusbaselineAUC contrasts. Descriptiveonly, never selecta differentcorrection afteraudit.
